text: どの　ポケモンに　するのか？

patterns.name: 〜にする
patterns.explanation: に plus する after a thing means you choose that thing. どの ポケモンに する = 'which Pokémon will you choose'.

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end makes a question that asks for the facts, here in a gruff male tone. するのか = 'will you pick, then?'.
